name: GUILD
long_description:
GUILD is an AI-native defense contractor making aerospace parts faster and cheaper than today’s supply chain. We win government contracts, turn technical requirements into production-ready workflows, and execute through factory integrations from RFQ to delivery.

We’ve built an AI-native operating model for defense contracting: a company brain that connects requirements, pricing, supplier capability, compliance, manufacturing, finance, and delivery so each contract makes the next one faster and cheaper.
one_liner: AI-Native Defense Contractor Reshaping the Defense Supply Chain
